Consider the following triangle, where the side ![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/linear/14191822/assets/721aa9559f1b9f3da3e69b1b9763327e29a6f3fb77157f4b42dd076d3865e098.svg) has been extended beyond the vertex ![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/linear/14191822/assets/278f99df1e14fe0ebfb61bdb72262a62670dcaa60d322148bc3ee591b278ec2d.svg)

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/linear/14191822/assets/6be676cc487d17815701f3783e9eca71d7491a0e63d7ae9016fb65ad801e61d6.png)

  

The resulting angle ![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/linear/14191822/assets/f1729f131b4ec04b45c992a99498753dd09d27e76e917dff66d1fd554ec2ab5e.svg) is called the **exterior angle** at vertex ![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/linear/14191822/assets/278f99df1e14fe0ebfb61bdb72262a62670dcaa60d322148bc3ee591b278ec2d.svg) 

Exterior angles have the following properties:

- An exterior angle and its corresponding interior angle form a linear pair and are therefore supplementary. Here, we have
![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/linear/14191822/assets/9ae2a4aa323b941eff72a50f5c1086c72e961d0eed919a327306e77cfd5a7ef6.svg)

- The measure of an exterior angle is equal to the sum of the measures of the two non-adjacent interior angles. This is called the **exterior angles theorem**. To see why it is true, notice that since the internal angles of a triangle sum to ![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/linear/14191822/assets/1ace39b6f52fbf0b8654fc88bfa3e97366d33e3c411580da106e513a498aca53.svg) we have 
![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/linear/14191822/assets/49aafbdb975ccd101e16c921c20630af6296b860438ebfb62d8a205cc6e7b3c7.svg)

- At each vertex of a triangle, there are two exterior angles. They are vertical angles, and consequently, they have the same measure.

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/linear/14191822/assets/b459ad1edd5e0fdf512d722eb55ab20ff66c281d7160077d12936a6926529aa0.png)
